title: PATCH /schedules/{id} – request
description: Change the given properties of a schedule; the route cannot change. With mode, the fields of the new mode are required and those of the other mode are cleared; without mode, only the fields of the current mode can be given. interval_from = interval_to is not allowed. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 200, api/schedule.response.json.

weekdays.description: Bit mask of start days: 1 = Monday, 2 = Tuesday, 4 = Wednesday, 8 = Thursday, 16 = Friday, 32 = Saturday, 64 = Sunday.

start_times.description: list mode: a sequence from the start day; an element not later than the previous one is on the next day (at most one such step, and then the last element is earlier than the first).

anyOf.description: Time limit of a round in minutes; null = no limit.
